---
title: quarto-graph
type: moc
---

Adds Obsidian-style wikilink functionality — linking, backlinks, and a
graph visualization — directly to your own Quarto project's pages.

This site is itself built with quarto-graph, and every page here is a real
page in this same Quarto project — there's no separate source directory.
If you can read this page, [[Getting Started]] already resolved as a real
link below.

## Start here

- [[Getting Started]] — install it, a few lines in `_quarto.yml`, done
- [[Wikilinks and Aliases]] — the linking syntax and how targets resolve
- [[Backlinks]] — the "pages that link here" section, injected live
- [[The Graph Widget]] — the full graph view and the sidebar mini-panel
- [[Limitations]] — what's not supported yet
- [[Under the Hood]] — the resolution pipeline, for when something goes wrong
